content.text: Submitted. The repaired proposal keeps the single preferred-level insertion at Section 4.3 but now states the two literal requirements expressly — "standard machine-readable format" and return "within 30 days after such expiration or termination" (replacing the imprecise "Termination Date" anchor and "commonly used" formulation) — with digit-first durations ("up to 6 months", "30 days"). All official precision checks and the minimality gate return ok:true.
